summary: Session 2 of 3 adds parameterized-query and parameter-dialog recognition to the usage-identification layer. Saved-query parameter metadata now survives load: IrQuery carries a new Parameters list populated by IrLoader.ExtractQueryParameters, which reuses the Access-layer QueryMetadataExtractor.ParseParameters scan (declared PARAMETERS entries + [Forms]!/[Reports]! control references) rather than re-implementing parsing. A new ParameterizedInput signal is emitted independently of the Q2-Q7 category branch, so a parameterized query used as a report RecordSource (Q3) now surfaces its parameter expectation instead of being lumped into generic reporting; its evidence covers declared parameters, form/report control references, inline bracketed prompts, and ODBC '?' markers. Rule F8 is fleshed out: an unbound form whose name matches *Param*/*Filter*/*Criteria*/*Dialog* is recognized as a likely parameter-collection dialog (e.g. frmReportParam_*, which Session 1 deliberately left Unknown). Per the strategy-doc F8 contract the form keeps the Unknown category (the question, not a positive category, is the deliverable) but is made distinguishable from a generic unknown form via the fired ParameterizedInput signal (evidence param-dialog-name-pattern + dialog-chrome + opened-as-dialog), a parameter-dialog summary, and a specific ParameterDialogFlow question that suppresses the now-redundant NoRecordSource/UnrecognizedVbaPattern questions. Queries get an additive ParameterizedQuery question that deliberately does not suppress the Session 1 OutOfBandEntryPossible question (the two probe different things). All new signal/summary state is threaded via explicit flags from the classifier decision (paramEvidence / parameterDialogForm), never recomputed from the object name in BuildSignals/BuildSummary, per the Session 1 calibration discipline. The contract is documented in docs/planning/object-use-identification-strategy.md (new §2b, §3.9, fleshed-out F8, §5b, §6 templates) and the schema enums (ParameterizedInput; ParameterizedQuery; ParameterDialogFlow). Pilot of identify-usage against the committed HomeHealthCare golden IR (temp dir; golden intentionally NOT regenerated — Session 3): the 5 frmReportParam_* forms go from F6 generic Unknown 0.30 to Unknown 0.45 with ParameterizedInput + ParameterDialogFlow (generic questions suppressed); the 2 declared-PARAMETERS queries (qryProviderPlansByClient_Param, qryClientServicePlan_ByClient) now surface ParameterizedInput + ParameterizedQuery; frmReportMenu stays a NavigationShell launcher (F8 correctly yields to the launcher rules). Hermetic AccessHarvester.Pipeline.Tests 814 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (incl. 13 new ParameterDialogTests; all Session 1 LauncherSurfaceTests unchanged and green); full-solution dotnet build 0 errors. Scope discipline held: no cleanup-pipeline changes, no COM changes, no golden regeneration, no duplicate-table/obsolete-module heuristics. Cross-provider verification gpt-5-4: R1 ISSUES_FOUND (2 Minor, test-coverage only — concerns 1-5 confirmed correct: missing regressions for the [Reports]! control-reference path and the ODBC '?' marker path) -> fixed test-only -> R2 VERIFIED (empty issues). Both findings resolved; verdict recorded as VERIFIED.
